claims.statement: The JPA Inspector edits existing entities, attributes, indexes and queries in place when an element is selected.
claims.supports: clicking an element shows its properties, which can be changed in place
claims.surfaceEquivalent: The Designer's Inspector edits, in place and through version-checked prepare and apply messages, entity attributes (column mapping and relationships, RS-941 exerciser and RS-989), existing @Table indexes and unique constraints, and existing literal @NamedQuery entries (name, columns, uniqueness, JPQL text; Java and Kotlin; RS-980 to RS-989, unit tests in designer_annotation_edit.rs, scripts/check-jpa-designer.mjs for the inspector sections). Entries that are not plain literal annotations stay listed but read-only. Not checked: selecting an element in a tool window (the Designer lists the open entity's entries and the user picks one in the Inspector), editing entities or named native queries and other elements, the original's inspector popup.
